metadata.explanation: Compositional hardening: agent must (1) convert all text to lowercase and (2) make the first paragraph (the document title 'Presentation Instruction') bold. Partial credit: 0.5 per sub-goal. Evaluator checks all alpha chars are lowercase AND all runs of the first non-empty paragraph have bold=True.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly collects all alphabetic characters from both paragraphs and tables, then checks all are lowercase — comprehensive coverage of sub-goal 1.
Getter correctly identifies the first non-empty paragraph as the document title and verifies all non-empty runs have run.bold is True — correct coverage of sub-goal 2.
Postconfig saves the file (Ctrl+S + sleep 2) before verification, ensuring the getter reads fresh on-disk state.
Metric function correctly uses result dict directly and does not misuse the expected parameter (which is an empty rules dict for type='rule').
Partial credit scoring (0.5 per sub-goal) aligns well with the two distinct requirements in the instruction.
Edge cases handled: empty alpha_chars returns False (not a trivially passing empty document); empty runs list returns False for bold.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: run.bold is True is a strict check that requires explicit run-level bold. If the title uses a bold heading paragraph style but the user did not apply run-level bold explicitly, the check returns False even if the text renders as bold. This is acceptable for verifying deliberate user action, but could be documented or relaxed to also accept style-inherited bold if needed.
